description: Elenco articolo senza prezzo al 31.12.2099 ma che hanno avuto almeno un prezzo di vendita che è scaduto nel 2025

targets.rawSql:
WITH LatestExpiredPrice AS (
    SELECT
        tsp.item_sale_id,
        MAX(tsp.end_date) AS max_end_date
    FROM
        tmd_sale_prices_var tsp
    WHERE 1=1 
    and promo_Code is null
     ----- and  tsp.end_date < CURRENT_DATE -- Prezzi la cui validità è già terminata
    GROUP BY
        tsp.item_sale_id
)
select
tis.id, 
    ti.item as Articolo,
    ttr.description as Descrizione_Articolo,
    tsp_latest.price AS Ultimo_prezzo_valido ,
    to_char(lep.max_end_date,'dd-mm-yyyy') AS Ulitma_data_fine_validita  
FROM
    tmd_items ti
INNER JOIN
    ttr_items ttr ON ttr.item_id = ti.id AND ttr.language_id = 1
INNER JOIN
    tmd_item_sales tis ON tis.item_id = ti.id
INNER JOIN
    tmd_saleable_assortments sa ON sa.item_sale_id = tis.id
-- LOGICA DI FILTRO MODIFICATA
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT sp.item_sale_id
    FROM tmd_sale_prices_var sp 
    WHERE sp.end_date >= '2025-01-01' and promo_Code is null -- **NUOVA CONDIZIONE: Fine data >= 2025-01-01**
    GROUP BY sp.item_sale_id
) AS FilteredPrices ON FilteredPrices.item_sale_id = tis.id
INNER JOIN 
    LatestExpiredPrice lep ON lep.item_sale_id = tis.id
INNER JOIN
    tmd_sale_prices_var tsp_latest ON tsp_latest.item_sale_id = lep.item_sale_id
                                   AND tsp_latest.end_date = lep.max_end_date
WHERE
    ti.item_type_pc = 2
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM tmd_sale_codes sc
        WHERE sc.item_sale_id = tis.id AND CURRENT_DATE BETWEEN sc.start_date AND sc.end_date
          AND sc.code_type_pc IN (5,1,4,10)
    )
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM tmd_sale_prices_var sp
        WHERE sp.item_sale_id = tis.id AND sp.end_date = to_Date('2099-12-31','yyyy-mm-dd') 
        and sp.promo_code is null
    ) 
    order by lep.max_end_date desc;

title: Articoli senza prezzo al 31.12.2099
